name: West Green Farm Orchard and Dairy
imageAlt: West Green Farm Orchard and Dairy
description: In Lebanon, CT, West Green Farm Orchard and Dairy raises Apples on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
